analysis: All changes in this batch are documentation only. docs/architecture/inference.md (changed head lines 1370-1382, the patch for which sits outside the supplied head excerpts at lines 1637+) adds a description of Qwen inline-MTP chained ordinary decode: hidden rows are appended to the assistant history, a carry is stored, and two rollback env switches exist (DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CHAINED and DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CARRY). docs/developer/test.md (patch at line 494) adds RuntimeConcurrencyBenchmark to a swift test filter. The supplied head_text units (lines 1637-2261) are surrounding context, not part of the changed range. They cover MiMo, Flint and Qwen4 native paths and the existing T-041/prefix-cache and TB-007 boundaries. I found no change to code, to the coordinator-provider wire contract, to attestation/authorization (TB-011, T-052..T-058), or to prefix-cache TTL, lookup naming or AAD. No endpoint, key-custody or encryption behavior changes. Remaining integration questions: the described MTP carry and hidden-row history are per-request decode state. The reviewed docs say nothing about whether the carry persists across requests or enters SSD prefix checkpoints. If the underlying code (EngineLoopV2+MTPOrdinaryHistory.swift, not supplied) retains the carry across tenants, T-028/T-041 could be affected. That is unverified and is not a finding here. The source change was not supplied, so the next pass should check it if it is in the PR.
